Better Harness harness

Collect privacy-safe project and session evidence for AI interpretation by the Better Harness skill, then validate AI-authored findings and derived Markdown, HTML, or Qoder Canvas reports while keeping AI Agent Practices visible.

Usage:
  better-harness harness <SUBCOMMAND> [ARGS]

Subcommands:
  Audience: maintainer
  evidence-bundle          Collect the three specialist lanes and lead evidence in one
                           frozen-context bundle
  workspace-topology       Resolve the Git-aware workspace target and member topology
  analyze                  Return a neutral, budgeted Harness evidence brief
  checkup                  Scan agent customizations and produce a read-only cleanup plan
  selection-profile        Build a privacy-safe session selection profile
  source                   Build the deterministic Agent Work Loop source envelope
  source-review            Create, compile, and apply a bounded report-source review
  task-loop-report         Project deterministic task-loop findings from report.source.json
  render                   Render reviewed findings data into report artifacts
  preview-canvas           Preview a Qoder Canvas report on this machine
  report-quality           Validate Markdown report and findings JSON readiness contracts
  repair-findings          Normalize findings JSON schema drift
  record-fix-output        Record the latest verified output and Assignment Summary for one
                           finding
  validate-canvas          Validate Qoder Canvas output parity and runtime boundaries

Examples:
  better-harness harness analyze --workspace . --language en --format json
  better-harness harness checkup --phase scan --provider qoder --workspace . --json
  better-harness harness workspace-topology --workspace . --json
  better-harness harness source --workspace . --source <scratch>/report.source.json --language en
  better-harness harness source-review create --source <scratch>/report.source.json --packet <scratch>/review.packet.json --decision <scratch>/lead.decision.json --json
  better-harness harness render --findings <input>/findings.json --mode qoder-canvas --out .qoder/better-harness --target . --validate --json
  better-harness harness preview-canvas <run>/report.canvas.tsx --open
  better-harness harness report-quality --report <run>/report.md
  better-harness harness validate-canvas --canvas <run>/report.canvas.tsx

Discovery:
  better-harness harness --help --audience advanced
  better-harness harness --help --audience maintainer

Options:
  -h, --help              Print help
